scope: Italian champions as officially recognised by the FIGC: Campionato Italiano di Football / Prima Categoria / Prima Divisione / Divisione Nazionale finals (1898-1929, decided by final rounds or finals) and Serie A (1929-30 onward)
source: https://www.rsssf.org/tablesi/italchamp.html (RSSSF champions list, cross-check of every champion)
Wikipedia season articles (YYYY–YY Serie A) league tables, cross-check and missing points

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses)
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now (2026-27), without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points after deductions (2 points per win until 1993-94, 3 from 1994-95); null for seasons decided by finals
fieldNotes.name: club name used in the source for that season (e.g. Ambrosiana-Inter 1929-45)
fieldNotes.tournament: "FIGC"/"CCI" for the two rival championships of 1921-22, otherwise null
fieldNotes.tiedWith: other clubs sharing the same position (Italian tables listed tied clubs level); present only on tied placings
fieldNotes.strippedChampion: club that finished first but whose title was revoked and not reassigned (1926-27 Torino, 2004-05 Juventus); champion is null in those seasons
